lesson.menu_title: Reporting a Problem -- Because and So
lesson.menu_desc: Relatar um atraso de matéria-prima em três frases: o que aconteceu, por quê (because) e o que acontece agora (so) -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- Reporting a Problem
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 21 -- Reporting a Problem
lesson.grammar_point: because and so (connectors of cause and result)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it's Tom. Bad news from New Jersey. Our delivery to Brazil is late, because the truck had a problem on the highway. The material is safe, so you don't need to worry. The new truck leaves tomorrow morning, so the material arrives at the port on Friday. Sorry for the delay. Call me if you need more information.

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora, from the New York office. A small change for your visit. The meeting on Monday is now on Tuesday, because the director is in Chicago on Monday. So on Monday you are free in the morning. Maybe you can visit the Museum of Modern Art! See you soon.

extra_audio.text: The vanilla for Paris arrived at the port of Santos. Customs was very slow, so the vanilla stayed at the port. Rodrigo called Claire because the order was late. He explained the problem in three sentences. Now the vanilla is at the plant, so the order is ready.
